data.name: Ajy
data.gender_notes: Ajy is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit root ‘aj’ meaning ‘not’ and ‘asan’ meaning ‘pain’, Ajy signifies ‘the absence of pain or suffering’. It is the name of a deity in Hindu mythology associated with the concept of immortality and eternal bliss. The name Ajy carries the meaning “Breath of Life” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ajy usually hope their child will grow to embody breath of life and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the pursuit of a pain-free and joyful existence.
data.etymology: Ajy belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Breath of Life.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ajy total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
